title: Quote tick
description: A changing quote retains its previous value and emphasizes the direction of each update.
useCase: Make metric changes legible without asking a user to remember the last number.
interaction: Apply an up or down tick and compare the previous value and signed difference.
reducedMotion: Numbers and signed differences update immediately without vertical motion or fading.
limitations: Manually generated example values, not market data or an investment interface.
look: Near-black panel with a large white tabular price, a monospace row comparing previous value and green delta, a tick-mark ruler and underlined text buttons.
motion: Each update remounts the price, which fades in while sliding 8 px up (gain) or down (loss) over 220 ms ease-out, tinted green or red for 800 ms.
adapt: The entrance is the `quote-w2` keyframes on `.number`, restarted by `key={quote.id}` with direction from `--tick-travel`; the colour flash is `data-flash`, cleared by an 800 ms `setTimeout`. Call `update` with deltas from your feed instead of the fixed `-0.37` and `0.52` buttons.
